body: So I looked at my project settings to see if anything looked suspicious, and what ended up fixing it was changing the `rendering/rendering_device/driver.windows` to vulkan. It seems very likely to crash (maybe always) with d3d12. Do you think I need to update my drivers again, or could this be a godot bug?

Tested on 4.6 stable, 4.7 stable and 4.8 dev 1, all versions crash in the same way. From my tests the culprit are two png files: `vfx\decals\puddle_a_orm.PNG` and `vfx\decals\rough_orm.png`, both files are 1x1 and use `Compress Mode = VRAM Compressed`. Opening the MRP or setting these files compress mode to `VRAM Compressed` or `Basis Universal` throw the following errors: ``` ERROR: CreateResource failed with error 0x80070057.  ERROR: servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:1694 - Condition "!texture.driver_id" is true. Returning: RID()  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:1042 - Condition "texture.rd_texture.is_null()" is true.  ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:2078 - Parameter "tex" is null.  ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:2087 - Parameter "tex" is null.  ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:2108 - Parameter "tex" is null.  ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:2124 - Parameter "tex" is null.  ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:2116 - Parameter "tex" is null.  ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:2087 - Parameter "tex" is null.  ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:1892 - Parameter "tex" is null.  ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:967 - Parameter "t" is null. ``` And using DebugView and opening Godot with `--gpu-validation` i also get: `D3D12 ERROR: ID3D12Device::GetResourceAllocationInfo: Textures created with certain Formats must align the resource dimensions properly. D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC::Format is BC1_TYPELESS. D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC::Width is 1, and must be a multiple of 4. D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC::Height is 1, and must be a multiple of 4. [ STATE_CREATION ERROR #597: CREATERESOURCE_INVALIDDIMENSIONS]`
As mentioned by OP, this only happens with `D3D12`, `Vulkan` don't throw any errors even with `--gpu-validation` and don't crash when interacting with these files. The only strange detail was the fact the errors or the crash don't happens with the executables i compile by myself.
IIRC we already had an issue for 1x1 pngs crashing
